PREMIUM WORDPRESS · PRELAUNCH

Theme details.

An asymmetrical, luxury editorial block theme for independent restaurants, tasting rooms, private dining, and chef-led concepts. This is a fictional design prototype, not a real restaurant or active booking website.

What is included

  • Native WordPress block theme (WordPress 6.6+, PHP 8.0+)
  • Editable Signature Homepage pattern, menus, service cards and reservation CTA
  • Homepage, posts, page, archive, search and 404 templates
  • Header and footer editable in Site Editor
  • Three preset palettes: Ink & Champagne, OxBlood & Bone, Olive & Porcelain
  • Five original generated concept images
  • Reduced-motion styling and responsive layout
  • Installation, plugin, and customization instructions

Use cases

Fine dining, chef's tables, bistros, tasting menus, wine bars, boutique restaurants, intimate events.

File types: WordPress block theme (.zip; HTML templates, PHP pattern, CSS, JSON, WebP). Hosting: Self-hosted WordPress or a plan allowing custom themes.

Plugin requirements

CapabilityPlugin needed?
Native layout, editable menu presentation, blogNone
Accept live reservationsInstall and configure Five Star Restaurant Reservations or an alternative
Manage dynamic menu itemsOptional: Five Star Restaurant Menu; native menu pattern works without it
Online orders / gift cardsNot implemented. Would require WooCommerce or another integration plus testing.

Reservation plugin recommendation: Five Star Restaurant Reservations, which provides a Booking Form block or [booking-form] shortcode after separate installation. No plugins are bundled.

Store status: Prelaunch prototype. Price not finalized; theme package should not be publicly downloadable before testing and purchase setup.
